accepted.reason: a lone "-" selects no code whether it is read as the pattern "-" or as turning off the empty pattern
a platform with exactly two parts is rebuilt as the same os/arch string, so trimming it too changes nothing
ShellCheck codes start at SC1000, so rejecting a code of exactly 1 as well changes nothing a real report can contain; the line bound on the same condition is tested
git always closes a hunk header with @@, so a header has at least three fields and never exactly two
without SkipDir the walk descends into the excluded directory, but every entry below it is excluded too; skipping only saves the walk

the capacity is only a preallocation hint; append grows the slice either way
mutable drops testdata and vendor paths itself and .git holds no Go files, so skipping these directories only saves the walk
a reference starting with a slash names no check whether it is split or not, and the error quotes the whole reference either way
only a modification time exactly racyWindow before the hash, to the nanosecond, tells < from <=; no test can arrange that
